## How the sign-in works

The browser never sees the password check itself: it is redirected to the identity provider, which hands back a short-lived code, and the app exchanges that code server to server [1].

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant B as Browser
  participant A as App server
  participant I as Identity provider
  B->>A: Open the app
  A-->>B: Redirect to sign-in
  B->>I: Sign in
  I-->>B: Redirect with code
  B->>A: Return with code
  A->>I: Exchange code for tokens
  I-->>A: ID token
  A-->>B: Session cookie
```

The cookie is the only thing the browser keeps. When it expires, the same round trip runs again, usually without a prompt because the provider still remembers the user.
